newsitem.title: USA: Digi Intl sees Q1 revs of $42-$42.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Digi Intl sees Q1 revs of $42-$42.5 mln.

text.p: Digi International Inc said Wednesday it expects to report revenues for its fiscal first quarter in the $42.0 million to $42.5 million range, including rebates of about $1.3 million.
This compares to revenues for the same year-earlier period of $43.7 million, adjusted to reflect rebates of $150,000.

The company said revenue expectations are below analysts' range of estimates. As a result of the shortfall, Digi said it expects to report an operating loss for the quarter for its consolidated operations, not including AetherWorks Corp.
Digi's fiscal first quarter ended December 31.
In December, the company said it expected first quarter earnings below analysts' estimates.

"As previously announced, OEM (original equipment manufacturer) revenues were down significantly, which affected our North American sales," said Jerry Dusa, acting chief executive of the company. "However, we did post record sales from our international operations."
Digi provides data communications hardware and software.
